snippet.title: 🛡️ Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for an epic adventure! Our indomitable Gauls leave their village for an extraordinary journey through the Parthian Empire in Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon.

Add the game to your wishlist!
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489240/Asterix__Obelix__Mission_Babylon/
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015356
- Xbox: https://xbox.com/games/store/asterix-obelix-mission-babylon/9NPQB3DKDMGC/

🎮 A brand new adventure awaits:
- Save King Monipehni from deadly poison
- Explore 4 spectacular worlds including Babylon
- Fight Roman legionaries in local co-op
- Discover twenty action-packed levels

Developed by Balio Studio and published by Microids, this action platformer promises humor, epic battles and surprises!

🎯 Available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and PC

By Toutatis, these Romans are crazy!

#AsterixAndObelix #comicbooks #Microids #Platformer #coop
